answer: Locks are logged in mesa, expire in wharf, and sonnet lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 145 aliases thus needs 196 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 891 identities would post 549 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
